theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A charity and community group in Kerala dealing with financial contributions, medical aid, and death benefits requires a UI that feels highly trustworthy, grounded, and empathetic. Dark mode or harsh tech colors feel inappropriate and clinical. A light, earthy theme builds community trust.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. The 'Control Room' grid protocol for dashboards. High density for tables, but ample padding for distinct sections.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Optical alignment for icons and text.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-stone-200), no heavy shadow by default. Hover adds slight shadow-sm.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid white background (bg-white/95) with subtle bottom border (border-stone-200), backdrop-blur-md if sticky.
surface_strategies.modals: Crisp edges, rounded-md, flat white background, dark overlay (bg-stone-900/40).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements must transition colors smoothly (transition-colors duration-200). Background darkens slightly, text maintains contrast.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in for data grids and staggered entrance for lists.

component_rules.buttons: Flat, rectangular (rounded-md). Primary uses bg-[#166534] text-white. Secondary uses bg-stone-100 text-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-200.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn defaults customized with rounded-md, border-stone-300, focus:border-[#166534].
component_rules.tables: Shadcn table component. Dense rows. text-sm. Hover effect on rows (hover:bg-stone-50).
component_rules.cards: Avoid overusing the Shadcn Card wrapper with heavy drop shadows. Use raw HTML divs with border-stone-200 and bg-white for a cleaner, auditable financial look.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use Phosphor Icons in 'regular' or 'duotone' weight. Duotone for dashboard navigation items, regular for action buttons.

login_hero_bg.description: Lush and tranquil tropical scenery in Kadalundi, Kerala, India - use for login page background overlayed with bg-stone-900/50

auth_alternative_bg.description: Tranquil tropical scene with palm trees - alternative for marketing or auth screens

community_placeholder.description: Joyful family moment - use for dashboard welcome banners or member success stories

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Set up standard CSS variables in index.css based on the colors object provided in this JSON.
Prioritize data clarity and trust over heavy graphics. Use the provided typography hierarchy strictly.
Implement role-based routing (Super Admin, President, Treasurer, Secretary, Member) with distinct sidebars.
Use data-testid attributes on all buttons, links, form inputs, and major layout wrappers.
